659615.title: Nick and the Jade Tree
659615.overview: Nick is a caterpillar boy who, having overcome the taboo of the swamp, becomes a butterfly and, regardless of difficulties, strives for his dream - the Magic jade tree, where all the most beautiful butterflies of the world live. Dangerous trials, fun adventures, new friends and, of course, first love await Nick on his way.

675871.title: Super Troopers 3
675871.overview: When Farva's over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny's sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny's schemes to break up the relationship, all while trying to bring down a pernicious new drug ring.

865567.title: Where the River Begins
865567.overview: Yajaira, a young but strong Embera woman, lives with her daughter Maria in a violent Bogotá neighborhood. Haunted by dreams of the jungle, she longs to return to the village she once called home. After a tragedy strikes, they have no choice but to leave. Jhon, a charismatic young gang member, joins them on their dangerous journey to the Andágueda River, driven by motives he keeps hidden.  Donde Comienza el Río is a poignant, poetic film where a perilous escape becomes a journey of healing. As the jungle reemerges through memory and dream, masks fall and reality is touched by the magic of Yajaira’s inner world.

887583.title: Analog Eyes
887583.overview: A loner dork gets fed up with the monotony of his existence under the shadow of his narcissistic friend. Forcing the the pair to reevaluate their place in life.

1001375.title: Dust
1001375.overview: When Belgian tech visionaries Luc and Geert learn that their fraud will hit the papers in less than 24 hours, they realise their company and their status will evaporate. With jail time becoming inevitable, they each go on their separate paths of redemption. As they quietly seek atonement from their investors – their families and the close-knit community, they learn what truly matters.

1032863.title: The Love Hypothesis
1032863.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

1049439.title: The Golden Age
1049439.overview: Born at the turn of the century in a village's butcher shop, Jeanne Lavaur dreams of becoming a countess. Inspired by the fearless Céleste and guided by her love for Guillaume de Barante, Jeanne’s journey carries her from the vibrant Paris of the Golden Twenties through the turmoil of two world wars. As her life intertwines with the great upheavals of the 20th century, she rises as a fiercely free woman, determined to never let anyone else define who she is meant to be.

1162975.title: 18 Youth
1162975.overview: Eighteen-year-old Soon-jeong dreams of escaping to Australia, but her strict homeroom teacher blocks her plans by denying her permission to miss night study for work. When mysterious classroom window break-ins trigger a school investigation, the pressure mounts. Can Soon-jeong endure it all and graduate as planned?

1196831.title: A Guardian's Heart
1196831.overview: Jake Bishop has been an exemplary Executive Protection Medic with a distinguished career but life hasn't always been that way for him. There have been miscues, failures, wrong turns and one day he just decides to walk away from it all. His ex boss wants to hire him for one final mission together and when Jake senses redemption for all life's twist and turns, will they survive and can the thought of love save him just in time from a path of destruction. Only time will tell.

1262687.title: Alpine Ballad
1262687.overview: 1943. Soviet soldier Ivan escapes from a death camp in the Italian Alps. However, his plans are thwarted by two unexpected companions: the famous German film star Dieter Schulze and the Italian anti-fascist Giulia.

1268127.title: Humint
1268127.overview: A South Korean agent hunts a drug ring in Russia and goes head-to-head with a North Korean operative — pulling both into peril and tangled secrets.

1297311.title: Quantum Supremacy
1297311.overview: In a future threatened by rogue robots and an all-powerful AI, Captain Monroe and his crew race to prevent humanity's downfall in Quantum Supremacy.

1308767.title: Young Washington
1308767.overview: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

1330271.title: Jimmy
1330271.overview: In November 1948, James Baldwin left New York and, thanks to a fellowship grant, relocated to Paris. The 24-year-old writer would spend most of the next decade there, escaping American racism and his own social alienation, ensconcing himself in the city’s Algerian quarters and the community of Left Bank artists in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, and writing his first books.

1341023.title: All This Time
1341023.overview: Trapped inside a gothic mansion in an endless time loop, Grace must unlock the secrets of the house, the enigmatic owner, and the previous night's party, to find any hope of escaping and returning to her normal life and young child.

1376415.title: The Money Maker
1376415.overview: In post-war France, Jan Bojarski, a young Polish refugee, became the greatest counterfeiter of all time, the "Cézanne of counterfeit money". For more than fifteen years, this man led a double life, unbeknownst to his family, making counterfeits in a garden shed that were "truer" than the bills issued by the Banque de France... All these years, this peerless counterfeiter managed to avoid being caught by the police, and became the bête noire of Commissaire Mattei in a hunt that, for these two obsessives, turned into a duel.

1380895.title: Sweetness
1380895.overview: When a chance encounter with her rockstar crush leads 16-year-old Rylee to discover that he's a dysfunctional drug addict, she takes it upon herself to help him, ultimately forcing her teenage fantasies into reality.

1381087.title: Monitor
1381087.overview: A social media moderator unleashes a deadly terror when she refuses to publish a cryptic video.

1381151.title: Holy Days
1381151.overview: When young Brian discovers plans to close a convent of delightfully eccentric nuns, he sets off with them on a wild road trip across New Zealand to save their home.

1430303.title: Home A Loan
1430303.overview: A tenacious mother Eun-jin forces her family to move into a rundown apartment, hoping for a luxurious rebuild. However, she loses her sanity as her plan fails and becomes harmful to those who she vowed to protect.

1430815.title: A Good Little Soldier
1430815.overview: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.
1430815.trailerName: A GOOD LITTLE SOLDIER - Official Trailer

1431071.title: System
1431071.overview: When Neha Rajvansh, a privileged public prosecutor, meets Sarika Rawat, a courtroom stenographer from a humble background, their lives are thrown into upheaval where power defines truth, blurring the system and raising a question of what justice truly means to them.
1431071.trailerName: System Trailer Drops Ahead of Prime Video Premiere

1433055.title: Suffocation
1433055.overview: In an elite high school swimming team plagued by a sinister curse, five teens unwittingly unleash a chain of deadly events after exposing a forbidden teacher-student affair through a leaked video. As the curse reawakens, they must confront betrayal and despair while racing to uncover the truth and break the cycle of death, only to realize they are destined to become each other’s undoing.

1440735.title: Couple Friendly
1440735.overview: Couple Friendly follows the journey of a Telugu boy and girl who both reside in Chennai. Their paths cross under unique circumstances, and the story deals with the challenges they face in their careers and relationship. Set in a city where they don't speak their mother tongue, the film explores the emotional highs and lows of navigating life and love in an unfamiliar environment.

1441183.title: North Station
1441183.overview: A lonely oceanarium worker, 29-year-old Sveta is afraid of close relationships, replaces them with casual one-night stands and lives on autopilot. One day, she is asked to come forward with accusations of harassment against a university professor, Pavel Rudin, with whom the girl once had an affair. But it turns out that Sveta is still in love with Rudin and is ready to defend him at all costs. But to do this, she will have to face her past...

1442399.title: Takshakudu
1442399.overview: A blind tribesman and his dog embark on a dangerous quest to face the evil force that burned his village to ashes during one cursed night.

1442975.title: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi
1442975.overview: What begins as a casual fling between a married man, Ram a.k.a Satya and Manasa in the middle of an international business trip, balloons into an out-of-the-blue mess when the latter lands in Hyderabad, disrupting Ram’s otherwise stable marriage with Balamani.

1450527.title: Forbidden Fruits
1450527.overview: Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of the mall store after hours - with fellow fruits Cherry and Fig. But when new hire Pumpkin challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.

1468383.title: Faust
1468383.overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.
1468383.trailerName: FAUST Official Trailer - Student Short Film

1473439.title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
1473439.overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

1477087.title: Ingeborg Bachmann – Jemand, der einmal ich war
1477087.overview: Sandra Hüller portrays Ingeborg Bachmann on an imaginary day in Rome. Regina Schilling’s hybrid film weaves together reenactments, archival footage, and Bachmann’s own writings into a portrait that offers a refreshing new perspective on the author and positions her writings as a reference point in current debates on gender relations and power.

1478111.title: Christmas Eve
1478111.overview: An anthology of seven incredible true stories that happened on Christmas Eve around the world.

1484319.title: Niko
1484319.overview: In the troubled night of Seoul on the verge of apocalypse, Niko, a penniless scriptwriter, works a part-time job as a companion for people who have lost their keys. When she can no longer satisfy her longing for true love in this once melancholic, sensual, and bustling city, she disappears. Her boyfriend Jeremy and their new friend Ji-eun start looking for the missing Niko and become entangled in a love triangle. At last, Niko finds a new, reckless, and ultimate way to express her feelings.

1492127.title: Viper
1492127.overview: Following a nuclear holocaust, an elite team of soldiers is sent into a condemned zone to destroy a bio-weapons lab.

1493983.title: Sea Sons
1493983.overview: Three young men run to the sea to find themselves and new meanings.

1497567.title: The Film About Edith
1497567.overview: The day she starts speaking Swedish, 28-year-old Norwegian Edith also dreams herself into the center of a movie. But it turns out that changing languages isn’t enough to make her the main character.

1497823.title: You Believe in Angels, Mr. Drowak?
1497823.overview: Lena is a cheerful student who firmly believes in happiness and the good in people. As part of a social project, she is sent by the office as a writing coach to Hugo Drowak, who has long since lost his luck and lives alone in a run-down tower block.
1497823.trailerName: SIE GLAUBEN AN ENGEL, HERR DROWAK? | Trailer | demnächst im Kino

1498015.title: Cordélicos: A Origem do Cabra da Peste

1509599.title: Gatta Kusthi 2
1509599.overview: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.
1509599.trailerName: Gatta Kusthi 2 | Official Trailer | Releasing at PVR INOX on July 3!

1513183.title: What is the matter?
1513183.overview: Four couples. One night that was supposed to be perfect… but everything turned into chaos. Between expectations, pressure, and inexperience, every story takes an unexpected turn. Awkward situations, wrong decisions, and endless disasters…
1513183.trailerName: الاعلان الرسمي لفيلم الكلام على إيه (أول_ليلة) | 14 مايو في السينما  #الكلام_على_إيه #أول_ليلة

1514847.title: Iván & Hadoum
1514847.overview: Iván (33), a trans man, and Hadoum (30), a Spanish-Moroccan woman, fall in love at the industrial greenhouse they work in. While facing the opposition from their families and co-workers, Iván realizes he doesn’t need to be the man he is expected to be.

1515615.title: Kissing Is the Easy Part
1515615.overview: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

1522079.title: Sathi Leelavathi
1522079.overview: Leelavathi is a successful and spirited film director whose marriage with Ram Sethu begins falling apart. The relationship is strained by ego, changing gender roles, and the husband feeling overshadowed by his wife's success. Things complicate further when Sethu asks for a divorce and admits he has feelings for another woman, Nicola Sebastian. The couple is then forced to confront unresolved feelings and unearth hidden truths about their marriage.
1522079.trailerName: Sathi Leelavathi - Movie Trailer | Lavanya Tripathi | Dev Mohan | Satya Tatineni | Mickey J Meyer

1530591.title: Pinjar
1530591.overview: ‘Pinjar’ is an evocative meditation on captivity—of bodies, of spirits, of choices—unfolding through the entangled lives of five individuals and a wild bird.

1555871.title: All My Sisters
1555871.overview: Growing up in Tehran, a capital of the 21st century... From 2007 to 2025, within a loving family, eighteen years in the life of three sisters, from their early childhood to their daily lives as young women in search of freedom. Brought up in the traditional way, witnessing the struggles of a youth in perpetual movement, what is their future in today's Iranian society?

1575647.title: It Hunts
1575647.overview: An aimless nightcrawler races to unravel the mystery of the supernatural entity hunting him.

1576223.title: Rage
1576223.overview: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

1578079.title: Dorothy
1578079.overview: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

1583583.title: Banshee
1583583.overview: An Irish folk horror short filmed in Donegal, Ireland.
1583583.trailerName: Banshee | Official Trailer HD | Tír Films

1588895.title: Finding Goldfinger
1588895.overview: A coming-of-age historical fiction story about Pierre Joubert, a diver with depth recovery unit and the first recorded diver to salvage gold off the ship, The Birkenhead.

1589663.title: Yang Lain Boleh Hilang Asal Kau Jangan
1589663.overview: Kesha, a final-year film student, lives in a warm family with her mother who also her beloved teacher, Yuke. However, their lives change when Yuke begins to experience increasingly severe memory loss. Amidst this, Kesha is faced with a major dilemma, continue pursuing her dreams or return home to avoid missing out on moments with her mother before it's too late.
1589663.trailerName: OFFICIAL TRAILER - YANG LAIN BOLEH HILANG, ASAL KAU JANGAN

1592031.title: The Great Money Robbery
1592031.overview: Pushed by betrayal, bullying, and desperation, Wu Xiaobao is drawn into an armed bank robbery and slowly descends into a dark, irreversible path.

1593055.title: How to Conquer the World
1593055.overview: What will be left behind when humanity vanishes from the surface of the earth? Abandoned stations, schools and plants create a post-apocalyptic landscape of the world without people.

1594719.title: Bullet and Lace
1594719.overview: Bullet and Lace, a neon-soaked, Giallo-inspired nightmare, follows a young woman whose favorite true crime podcast becomes the voice of the masked intruder stalking her through the night.

1596319.title: Closure
1596319.overview: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

1596767.title: Nightmare's Advice
1596767.overview: Lucie, a PhD student without a work visa and plagued by insomnia, is trapped in a destructive affair with her thesis advisor while being pursued by a jealous ex. Seeking help from a reclusive shaman on the city’s edge, she meets Béatrice, a young woman as carefree as she is determined to help her.

1597535.title: Breast Friends Forever
1597535.overview: Beauty-and-breasts besties Astrid Lee and Audrey Avila team up with sharp-tongued detective and comedy legend Janno Gibbs to solve the hilarious case of men getting way too… well, inflated.

1602783.title: Thaai Kizhavi
1602783.overview: An elderly and feared moneylender from a village near Madurai falls seriously ill, prompting her estranged sons and extended family to reunite after years of separation. As tensions rise inside the household, hidden motives, family conflicts, and expectations over her wealth turn her uncertain condition into the center of a chaotic family drama.

1606687.title: Still Night, Burning House
1606687.overview: In her deeply personal debut feature, award-winning filmmaker Carol Nguyen charts her family’s first reunion since her uncle’s mysterious death. Travelling together to Vietnam, the family embarks on a revelatory—and at times uncanny—journey through intergenerational trauma and many-layered loss. With care and probing curiosity, Nguyen guides her loved ones as they navigate unsealed medical records and a decades-long silence, ultimately leading them back to each other. A metaphysical poem for complex mourning, Still Night, Burning House shows how storytelling can transform grief into collective healing.

1610975.title: Shedites
1610975.overview: A comedy about a place where men can make themselves useful and along the way, find company through unlikely friendships, a sense of purpose and a mug of strong tea.

1611167.title: EESHAN - THE PROTECTOR
1611167.overview: An upcoming Indian feature film currently in development.  The project approaches myth and futurism with restraint, exploring responsibility, balance, and human choice without spectacle or exposition.
1611167.trailerName: INTO THE WORLD OF EESHAN | OFFICIAL GLIMPSE | EESHAN - THE PROTECTOR | RAHUL CHAKRADHAR | 4K

1611487.title: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas
1611487.overview: One minute. One mic. No mercy. Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests put up-and-coming comedians to the test at a relentless Austin showcase.

1612063.title: Twenty One Pilots: More Than We Ever Imagined
1612063.overview: Experience the electrifying concert film capturing Twenty One Pilots at a career-defining moment: their monumental Mexico City headline show, performing in front of 65,000 fans at Estadio GNP Seguros during The Clancy World Tour. Set against the vibrant pulse of one of the world’s most iconic music capitals, the film blends cinematic high-energy performance footage with intimate, behind-the-scenes access, revealing the heart, humor, and humanity of the artists as they prepare for one of the biggest shows of their career.
1612063.trailerName: Twenty One Pilots: More Than We Ever Imagined | Trailer Resmi Indonesia | Di Bioskop 26 Februari

1613791.title: Faux Amis
1613791.overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

1616543.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
1616543.overview: The first night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 11, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, marking the first time since 2019 that New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) opened its annual round-robin heavyweight tournament in the United States, and was headlined by an A Block match between Konosuke Takeshita and Yota Tsuji.
1616543.trailerName: 新日カードランブル presents G1 CLIMAX 36 オープニングVTR【勝て！叫べ！頂へ！】／2026.7.11 アメリカ・NOW ARENA〜8.16 東京・両国国技館

1623007.title: Chef’s Kiss
1623007.overview: Lauren travels to Italy to rebrand Russo Pasta Sauce, but her culture clash with Mason and Francesca's culinary heritage evolves into deeper revelations about love, life, and career priorities.

1623967.title: Before I Do
1623967.overview: A lakeside bachelor party weekend devolves into chaos when the groom and his best man’s past romantic feelings reignite, entangling the wedding party in the chaotic pre-wedding drama

1626527.title: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS The Making Of Magenta House
1626527.overview: SUFFICIENT SIDE EFFECTS is the definitive behind the scenes look at the making of Magenta House using extensive behind the scenes footage shot during the production of the film and interviews with most of the crew and some of the cast. It’s a unique opportunity to showcase the creation of fully independent student film which we had full control over. The good, the bad and the ugly side of film making is on full display going through all the ups and downs of such a production and hearing from those who created it both pre and post filming and right up to the film’s premiere at the Horror On Sea Film Festival.

1628639.title: The Death of Marion Wayne
1628639.overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

1629087.title: TOVAH
1629087.overview: Through exclusive interviews, rare archival footage, and intimate behind-the-scenes access, TOVAH traces Tovah Feldshuh’s ascent from a daring young actress to a Broadway institution and cultural icon.
1629087.trailerName: TOVAH | Star-Studded film on Broadway Legend Tovah Feldshuh - Film by David Serero - TRAILER (2026)

1629983.title: Робоняня
1629983.overview: Cheerful and inventive Zlata, who stays at home alone for the sake of the school ball and the first kiss, under the supervision of the newest robot nanny Notrix. Confident that she can easily trick the car, Zlata soon discovers that she is dealing with an invulnerable opponent who controls the entire house. Desperate, she and her neighbor Nikita, who is in love with her, find an unconventional way out - they begin to communicate with the robot in its language, using "perfect promts". Their friendship with their iron friend is rapidly gaining momentum and leads to a huge party, which turns into real chaos. It is at this moment that Zlata has to make a choice and understand what true friendship and self-sacrifice are.

1631711.title: Loja e Fundit
1631711.overview: Luizi, a forgotten singer, suddenly becomes famous overnight and all of Albania goes crazy. In order to protect his fame and win the heart of Kiara, the girl he loves, he must keep a lie alive, one that drags them both into a chain of hilarious and chaotic situations.

1635423.title: Zero Meets Hero
1635423.overview: War veteran Mr Thoi and his Gen Z grandson Tri Binh embark on a comedic journey to reunite with old war comrades, weaving together Vietnamese spiritual beliefs and generational bonds.
1635423.trailerName: NGHỈ HÈ SỢ NGHỈ HƯU | MAIN TRAILER | DỰ KIẾN KHỞI CHIẾU: 21.08.2026

1638303.title: No Limbs No Limits
1638303.overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

1643807.title: Effi o Blaenau
1643807.overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

1645599.title: Трасса «Море — море»
1645599.overview: A red convertible is speeding from St. Petersburg to Sochi, driven by the brazen photographer Tyoma. With him are his ex-wife, Sasha, and her new fiancé. Tyoma will do anything to prevent Sasha's new wedding. And the fatal hitchhiker Kira, rescued by the guys, will help him. Tyoma has only one way across the country to change and win back the love of his life-if his brakes don't fail.

1647071.title: Some Other Story
1647071.overview: Upon moving back to her hometown, a nostalgic Noelle reunites with her childhood flame Matthew to relive their final date before leaving their lingering feelings in the past. But will they be able to?

1647583.title: Looky-Loo: Part II
1647583.overview: Continuing where the first film left off, the looky-loo killer’s newfound infamy encourages him to push his crimes to further extremes as he documents his sadistic ventures, adding a new metatextual element to the film.

1647903.title: Interlinked
1647903.overview: Haunted by the scars of childhood bullying, JJ is a young man trying to outrun the anger and isolation that have followed him into adulthood. Pushing his body to its limits and navigating the pressures of city life, he begins to find unexpected peace in Layla a connection that offers warmth, intimacy, and the possibility of healing.  But as memories begin to blur with the present, the fragile stability JJ has built starts to fracture. Moments repeat, emotions spiral, and the line between past and reality grows increasingly uncertain. Through a fragmented journey of rage, vulnerability, and longing, JJ is forced to confront the parts of himself he has spent years trying to bury.  As the story unfolds, the truth behind JJ’s experience slowly emerges revealing a devastating portrait of trauma, perception, and the fragile ways the mind protects itself when pain goes unheard.

1648927.title: Frost Without Snow and Ice
1648927.overview: Over a decade on Svalbard, the fastest warming place on earth, Norwegian filmmaker Asgeir Helgestad witnesses the extraordinary life of a polar bear named Frost – a mother struggling to raise her cubs in a rapidly changing Arctic. This intimate journey transforms him from observer to storyteller, driven by his passion to connect with nature and to expose the devastating impacts of climate change on this fragile ecosystem.

1649887.title: Barbara - Becoming Shirin David
1649887.overview: Shirin David. Babsi. Barbara. Meet the woman behind the rap star as she balances fame, business and her identity in this intimate, emotional documentary.

1651231.title: I Am Mario
1651231.overview: Mario is a trans taxi driver who gets pregnant. He has the possibility of fulfilling his desire to become a father, but this confronts him with his expectations regarding his masculinity. Before exposing himself to a "macho" and prejudice-filled society, he must face himself.

1652831.title: Source Connection
1652831.overview: When an investigative reporter shows up to meet her source, he proves reticent at first, but then gives the information she's looking for. Together they're working to uncover the ills of the city.

1653151.title: Power-Man
1653151.overview: Power-Man, the masked vigilante of Vancouver, meets a new enemy when he seizes control of television and uses it to brainwash the people of the city to become his minions.

1657503.title: All That Exists
1657503.overview: A gripping human mystery following a journalist who uncovers a shocking truth behind a long-unsolved kidnapping case that spanned decades.

1658143.title: Me in a Nutshell
1658143.overview: A dimwitted yet curious creature gets stuck in a nutshell and does everything in his power to break out.

1659167.title: RECORDING #27 - Short Film
1659167.overview: A young man records video diaries for therapy, trying to make sense of a past he can’t fully remember. But as he reviews the footage, he begins to notice something unsettling..  What starts as a quiet attempt at healing turns into a slow unraveling, as he realizes a presence has been with him far longer than he thought… and may have never left.

1660575.title: Angel777
1660575.overview: Genc, an out of work fringe blogger devoted to anonymous research, lives with his partner Bora in Prishtina, Kosovo. While Genc holds on to hopes for a brighter future, Bora, burdened by financial strain, unfulfilled dreams, and fed up with his detachment, storms out after a heated argument. Now he must find where she’s gone before it’s too late for them.

1661855.title: Night Terror
1661855.overview: A woman battles lifelong sleep paralysis while living alone. As nightly episodes worsen her mental state, paranormal investigators suggest her condition may have supernatural origins.
1661855.trailerName: Night Terror (2026 ) | TEASER TRAILER | Supernatural Found Footage Horror

1665183.title: Enervo
1665183.overview: On the one-year death anniversary of her mother, Mikey is forced to face her inner demons while paralyzed as her guilt manifests itself into physical form.

1665695.title: Dr. Q
1665695.overview: A psychiatrist struggles to aid her stranded family and patients while grappling with her own mental state.

1675935.title: Helene Weigel - Revolutionärin im Rampenlicht
1675935.overview: Who was Helene Weigel? Using impressive archive material, the film follows the convinced communist, acting icon, and free spirit from her early days in theater to her escape from the Nazi regime to the founding and management of the Berliner Ensemble. The result is a powerful portrait that finally puts the “woman at Brecht's side” in the spotlight.

1678239.title: Lesbian Lines
1678239.overview: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

1685471.title: Somebody's Watching Me
1685471.overview: After a friend's bachelorette weekend, Lori receives a flash drive with footage from a hidden camera at their Airbnb. The footage is of her sleeping and then a masked stranger entering the room and watching her.

1688799.title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
1688799.overview: A documentary on Darlene Love, the singer and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee known for “He’s a Rebel” and collaborations with Cher, Bruce Springsteen, Dionne Warwick, Sam Cooke and other greats.

1688863.title: My Coluche
1688863.overview: It’s the story of two guys — a comedian and a journalist — who become friends and get up to all sorts of antics. It’s the story of two men reflecting their era. It’s the story of one man, Coluche, seen through the eyes of his friend, Michel Denisot. It’s the story of his Coluche.

1690207.title: Our Birthdays
1690207.overview: A seemingly ordinary Belgian family navigates the quiet weight of daily life, where silence speaks louder than words. As home videos and shared routines intertwine, subtle cracks in their world reveal a presence that refuses to fade, blurring the line between memory and reality in a tender reflection on love and lingering grief.

1692319.title: When people ask where you're from
1692319.overview: Sonja Aigner, born in South Africa and now living in Germany, reflects on identity and belonging after a DNA test reveals connections across the world.Through a quiet and intimate conversation, the film explores what it means to come from a place and whether that answer is ever complete.

1692383.title: Rx
1692383.overview: A slacker taking care of his ailing grandfather finds himself in over his head when he invites his best friend over to get high.

1693983.title: Jackie the Stripper
1693983.overview: A female empowerment grind house comedy action thriller. Jackie and her band of female vigilante assassins hatch a plan to kill six members of the evil male dominated court. With deadly and hilarious consequences

1694047.title: England 2006: The Golden Generation
1694047.overview: Documentary that explores why the men's England football team did not fulfil their potential at the 2006 World Cup, including insight and reflection from key members of the 'Golden Generation'.

1695327.title: Dream High: Show Musical on Stage

1700895.title: Папа, купи песика
1700895.overview: Milana receives a long-awaited gift from her parents—a puppy named Dippy. Her joy knows no bounds, but one day, while out for a walk, the girl gets distracted, and the puppy gets lost in the park, left all alone to face the big city. Dippy meets a street cat and a rat named Bangs, and even falls in love with a Chihuahua named Tabby. While Milana searches for her beloved pup, exciting adventures await Dippy—adventures in which he must become a true hero, capable of protecting not only himself but also his friends.

1701407.title: Identity V STAGE Episode 7 [Come to the Rescue]
1701407.overview: The seventh instalment in the Identity v Stage Franchise. Plot TBA.

1701855.title: Defending Europe
1701855.overview: For decades, European security has depended mainly on NATO, under-written by America. But under the Trump White House, the spectre of US disengagement threatens to leave the EU without its protector. We investigate the main threats facing Europe and examine how Europe can best defend itself.

1707935.title: The Sound of the Mountains
1707935.overview: A minimalist experimental film using symbolic imagery and color to reflect on Kurdish resistance, identity, survival, and rebirth through the enduring connection between people and land.

1708575.title: Permanent Trespass
1708575.overview: Two “professional mourners” meet within the ominous setting of an Art Nouveau villa. Who — or what — is being mourned? From Beirut to Sarajevo, what first appeared to be an intimate encounter gradually transforms into a singular confrontation with History.

1710239.title: If We Ever Make It To Someday
1710239.overview: Law student Cassian, can't seem to let go of his high school sweetheart, Victoria, who seems to have moved on without him. And there's this mystery girl that lingers in his mind like perfume in an old house. With the pressure of the future and the state of the world weighing heavily on him, how will Cassian confront everything he's trying to run from?

1711071.title: The Jealous Bride
1711071.overview: As Meg prepares for her wedding, the return of a woman from her fiancé's past ignites a wave of jealousy she can't contain. Consumed by doubt, she soon spirals into a dangerous obsession that threatens to destroy her love, her faith and her future.

1713503.title: Closing Hour
1713503.overview: A young woman is stalked by a man who is becoming increasingly infatuated with her.

1714015.title: Pet Shop
1714015.overview: Pet Shop works as an experiment on regret and suffering.  A juxtaposition of a dog in a pet shop and a window. Narrated from the perspective of God, or the Devil, the text recounts discussions a person has had with Him. The person accuses Him of destroying his life. This could be for a sin, a murder, or for falling in love with a person of the same sex.

1715359.title: The Damned Thing
1715359.overview: A coroner’s inquest into an inexplicable death reveals the presence of an enigmatic creature.

1716767.title: Knowing Gaze
1716767.overview: Knowing Gaze is a loving roast of gay culture. This animated short moves fluidly through a series of interconnected vignettes—from online personas to offline hookups, from the thrift store to the dance floor to the bathhouse.  Rendered in expressive brush strokes, the story unfolds as candid conversations carried by acidic dialogue and vulnerable interior monologues. At its core, the film probes the tenderness and tension of modern gay identity. Beneath a million witty one-liners, the soul cries out.

1717087.title: Cantuta: La Orden Secreta
1717087.overview: A journalist receives a clandestine confession from a former agent of the Colina Group, who reveals the secrets behind the La Cantuta disappearances and the brutal war against terrorism that shook Peru in the 1990s.

1718879.title: ROOMINATION
1718879.overview: An established author Laura finds herself in the only place she was hoping to avoid- her unsettling therapy session with the peculiar Dr. Heigold. The more the therapy goes on, a way out seems more and more unlikely.

1719519.title: The Underground - Incident Report
1719519.overview: An unnamed Underground Agent has reported a strange happening on a recent mission.

1719583.title: RokuGatsu
1719583.overview: 晴れた日を待ち望む中で、  若い女性は雨の多い春の美しさに気づく。  While longing for a sunny day, a woman learns to appreciate the beauty of a rainy spring.

1721375.title: The Magic Garden
1721375.overview: Two friends discover a hidden treasure, but both refuse to accept it. Together, they find a solution that will bring about a beautiful future for the entire village.

1721439.title: insomn
1721439.overview: Somn Moon, an overworked office worker, ends another monotonous day and dreams of a window embedded in his chest: an eerie portal into his unconscious. Inside, he encounters a haunting replica of himself.

1723807.title: Break
1723807.overview: With his shimmering scales, the Rainbow Fish is the most beautiful fish in the entire ocean. But he is also vain and proud, which alienates the other fish. As a result, he becomes increasingly lonely. When he eventually loses one of his beloved glittering scales, it is none other than the Little Blue fish who accompanies him on the search into the deepest parts of the ocean. An adventurous journey begins – and the Rainbow Fish learns that together we are much braver than alone, and that true friendship is more precious than the most magnificent coat of scales.

1723935.title: DUO
1723935.overview: When Mo's alcoholic stepfather sends him on a simple errand across the city, he's forced to drag along his estranged and insufferably religious old friend, Abdullah. And what should have taken a day quickly turns into the longest, most theologically exhausting, yet enlightening set of days of both their lives.

1724575.title: When you were here
1724575.overview: After her husband passed away, Elvia finds herself feeling lonely for the first time in nearly 60 years of marriage. At first, she struggles with grief, but eventually discovers a haven in the early light of sunrise, when she feels most inspired to write poetry.

When Chris learns that Tomy's father is in hospital with AIDS, their friendship falls apart – and Tomy suddenly finds himself torn between exclusion and the secrecy of his own family.

1729759.title: EVERY LIFE
1729759.overview: A 15-year-old boy wakes up in a mysterious attic and meets an entity who tells him the horrifying truth about the universe.

1732191.title: Interstice
1732191.overview: The narrative follows a lonely, broken young man whose ordinary reality collides with his surreal subconscious after he meets a young woman. As he journeys deeper into his dreams, he is forced to confront the uncomforting realities of modern love.

1732447.title: La Chandleur
1732447.overview: Albert, a young man in his twenties, lives alone in his grandfather's country house under one condition: he must take care of the farm animals. While getting ready for a date, he discovers that a fox has attacked the ducks in the coop. Determined to protect the last surviving goose, Albert cancels his dinner and spends the night waiting for the animal. But he realizes that what he is hunting is not just a simple fox, but a far more terrifying entity: the Chandleur.

1733279.title: The Return
1733279.overview: Ivan and Ana, a young couple from Belgrade, arrive to Begaljica to sell their grandfather's old house. The rural idyll, as well as meeting a friendly grandma, affects their relationship.

1734623.title: Del Sentimiento Trágico de la Muerte

1736415.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
1736415.overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

1742303.title: Marinella
1742303.overview: In the Milan of the economic boom, Maria Boccuzzi –aka Marinella –is a young Calabrian in search of redemption. At just 16 years old, she runs away from home for love, but that choice leads her down a path of solitude, marginalization and broken dreams. Abandoned and without ties, she ends up in prostitution, continuing to pursue her desire to become a dancer. It is precisely that hope, never extinguished, that leads her to death at the hands of a mysterious man. Marinella will not have justice, but telling her story is an act of rebellion: a way to give her the dignity that life has denied her.

1744607.title: Later.
1744607.overview: The invisible half of his brother's rap act, a 17-year-old beatmaker spends the night of the biggest show running errands. He steals an hour for his own music and gets caught for the one thing he did for himself.

1744799.title: ORPHIA
1744799.overview: A band defined by fame and excess reunites for a landmark concert. As old wounds resurface, Ravi, Ícaro, Anastasia, Theo, and Eva are forced to confront the consequences of their choices, the weight of guilt, and the boundaries between affection, dependency, and redemption. Amidst the chaos, music remains the only place where it is still possible to exist.

1745119.title: Алоха!
1745119.overview: Eduard is a lonely, terminally ill man in the final stages of cirrhosis. His life changes dramatically when he meets a delivery robot named Aloha. This chance night, full of sadness and unexpected friendship, becomes Eduard's final journey into himself, toward forgiveness and reconciliation with those he lost.

1752159.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
1752159.overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

1755423.title: The Trans Girl Next Door
1755423.overview: Yuta, a second-year middle school student, lives with his single mother. One day, a woman named Yuka suddenly appears at Yuta’s home. Yuka claims to be Yuta himself, having come from 10 years in the future—after enduring various hardships, he underwent gender confirmation surgery to become who she is now. Yuka urges Yuta to begin the process of gender transition as soon as possible, before he reaches adulthood. Although Yuta had begun to feel a slight sense of dissonance among his friends, he resists Yuka’s forceful pressure. A tug-of-war ensues between Yuka, who has chosen to live as a woman, and Yuta, who finds it difficult to accept that future.
1755423.trailerName: 映画『となりのとらんす少女ちゃん』本予告【2026年11月7日(土)公開】

1756767.title: Moth

Shut-ins linger at the edges of contemporary life while a solitary avatar embarks on a journey across deserts, suburbs, cornfields, casinos, and simulated worlds, searching for meaning amid the ruins of an image-saturated culture.
